answers.name: Augustus
answers.fact: The first emperor; the month of August is named after him.

answers.name: Nero
answers.fact: Blamed for the Great Fire of Rome in AD 64.

answers.name: Caligula
answers.fact: Supposedly planned to make his horse a consul.

answers.name: Marcus Aurelius
answers.fact: A Stoic philosopher who wrote the Meditations.

answers.name: Hadrian
answers.fact: Built the wall across northern Britain.

answers.name: Constantine
answers.fact: The first Christian emperor; founded Constantinople.

answers.name: Tiberius
answers.fact: Spent his later years on the island of Capri.

answers.name: Commodus
answers.fact: Fought as a gladiator, as in the film Gladiator.

answers.name: Trajan
answers.fact: The empire reached its largest extent under him.

answers.name: Diocletian
answers.fact: Split the empire into a four-ruler tetrarchy.

answers.name: Septimius Severus
answers.fact: Born in Libya; died in York.

answers.name: Caracalla
answers.fact: Gave citizenship to all free men of the empire.

answers.name: Nerva
answers.fact: The first of the 'Five Good Emperors'.

answers.name: Antoninus Pius
answers.fact: Built a second wall in Scotland.

answers.name: Galba
answers.fact: First of the Year of the Four Emperors, AD 69.

answers.name: Otho
answers.fact: Second of the four emperors of AD 69.

answers.name: Vitellius
answers.fact: Third of the four emperors of AD 69.

answers.name: Elagabalus
answers.fact: A teenage emperor famous for decadence.

answers.name: Aurelian
answers.fact: Built the Aurelian Walls around Rome.

answers.name: Julian
answers.fact: Tried to bring back the old gods.

answers.name: Theodosius I
answers.fact: The last to rule a united empire.

answers.name: Romulus Augustulus
answers.fact: The last Western emperor, deposed in 476.

answers.name: Constantine XI
answers.fact: The last Byzantine emperor, killed in 1453.

answers.name: Heraclius
answers.fact: A Byzantine emperor who fought Persia.

answers.name: Macrinus
answers.fact: The first emperor who wasn't a senator.

answers.name: Valentinian I
answers.fact: Died of a stroke while shouting at envoys.

answers.name: Honorius
answers.fact: Was emperor when Rome was sacked in 410.

answers.name: Arcadius
answers.fact: The first Eastern emperor after the split.

answers.name: Majorian
answers.fact: One of the last effective Western emperors.

answers.name: Julius Nepos
answers.fact: Often counted as the true last Western emperor.

answers.name: Zeno
answers.fact: Ruled the East when the West fell.

answers.name: Alexios I Komnenos
answers.fact: Asked the West for help, sparking the First Crusade.

answers.name: Irene
answers.fact: The first woman to rule as empress in her own right.

answers.name: Silbannacus
answers.fact: Known from just a couple of coins.

answers.name: Sponsian
answers.fact: Once thought fake; real coins suggest he existed.

answers.name: Hostilian
answers.fact: Died of plague in 251 after a few months as co-emperor.

answers.name: Didius Julianus
answers.fact: Literally bought the throne when the Praetorian Guard auctioned it in 193.
